issue.title: dsh: Claude Code 订阅的 Claude 模型被分到 Chat Completions 路由，thinking 签名与 cache_control 在 dsh↔网关之间丢失
issue.body:
## 现象

Claude Code 订阅（provider `claude`）的 Claude 模型，在 magpie 写给 dsh 的 `~/.dsh/profiles/*/cordis.patch.yml` 里被放进 `magpie`（`openai-completions`）路由，而不是 `magpie-anthropic`（`anthropic-messages`）。例如：

```yaml
      magpie:            # api: openai-completions
        models:
          - id: claude/claude-sonnet-5-5
            name: Claude Sonnet 5.5 · Claude Code
```

于是 dsh↔网关之间每一轮都经 Chat Completions 翻译，再由网关转成 Messages 交给 Claude Code 桥。Anthropic 的签名 thinking 块和 `cache_control` 在回程翻译中丢失——这正是 `MessagesFirst`（provider.go，#997：中转的 OpenAI URL 会丢 cache_control、缓存 0% 命中）要避免的损失，只是发生在 dsh 这一段。

## 根因

- `dshRouteOf`（internal/agent/dsh.go:1397）按 `catalog.Model.APIs` 分路由；
- `magpieModels`（internal/agent/route.go:233）只在 `e.Provider.Native(e.Model)` 非空时写 `APIs`；
- 订阅 provider 的 `Native()`（internal/provider/provider.go:1573）对账号型 provider 提前返回 `""`（请求经 Claude Code 桥执行）——所以订阅 Claude 落到兜底的第一条 Chat 路由。

但网关的 `/v1/messages` 完全能服务订阅模型（`serveClaudeSubscription` 的入口就是 Messages 语义，`OnMessages` 也已在网关侧把订阅 Claude 引到 Messages），dsh 侧却没跟上。

## 建议

`magpieModels` 对 `Native()==""` 且 `MessagesFirst(model)` 为 true 的模型补 `APIs=["anthropic"]`，让 `dshRouteOf` 自然把它们分进 `magpie-anthropic` 路由（Pi、omp、droid 的接线同样受益，它们的分组读同一个 `m.APIs`）。

我可以提一个相应修复的 PR（已带上按仓库标准写的失败用例）。

comments.body:
按你的建议实现了，推在 fork 分支 `fix/issue-batch-1025a`（[3053f99f](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/3053f99f)，skygunner/magpie），方案与致谢归你：`magpieModels` 对 `Native()==""` 且 `MessagesFirst(model)` 为真的模型补 `APIs=["anthropic"]`，`dshRouteOf\] 自然把它们分进 `magpie-anthropic`，Pi/omp/droid 读同一个 `m.APIs` 一并受益。

红→绿：`TestDshRoutesASubscriptionClaudeOnMessages`——登录中的 claude 订阅 + Anthropic 目录，修复前订阅的 Claude 模型只出现在 `magpie`（openai-completions）路由下、`magpie-anthropic` 路由整个不存在（正如你贴的 cordis.patch.yml）；修复后它在 `magpie-anthropic`，start 也落在该路由。`go test ./internal/agent`（1,448 ok）、`./internal/provider`（1,780 ok）全绿。

你提到可以带失败用例提 PR：上游现在收不了外部 PR，所以先把你的方案落到 fork；如果你的分支已经写好，贴出来覆盖这一版即可。

Fixed: dsh used to leave a Claude Code subscription on the openai-completions magpie route because `magpieModels` only set `m.APIs` when `Native()` was non-empty; a subscription's `Native()` is empty (its binary runs locally) while the gateway serves it on Anthropic Messages (`MessagesFirst`).

Change: `route.go` now also checks `MessagesFirst(e.Model)` and sets `m.APIs` to the Anthropic route. The subscription model now lands on `magpie-anthropic` and dsh sync picks it up.

Test: `TestDshRoutesASubscriptionClaudeOnMessages` was red on unmodified code (`magpie-anthropic lacks claude/claude-sonnet-5`), green after.

`gofmt -l` clean, `go build ./...` ok, `go vet ./internal/agent/` ok, `go test ./internal/agent/` passes (1 pre-existing failure `TestAgyShell` also fails on clean upstream/main).

Branch: `fix/3514-subscription-claude-dsh-messages`, commit `9d68cb86b820619c64f41ab1c8d2ef5fed0ab27d`. Fork branch ready for review; not a claim on ownership.

issue.title: droid: Claude models written to ~/.factory/settings.json use "generic-chat-completion-api", Droid errors on every startup

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 现象

每次启动 Droid 都会报：

> Error: Your custom model "claude/claude-opus-5-5" appears to be a Claude/Anthropic model, but is configured with provider "generic-chat-completion-api". For Claude models (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus), use "provider": "anthropic". See https://docs.factory.ai/cli/byok/overview for details.

会话本身还能用，但这个报错每次都会出现。我把 `custom:magpie/claude/claude-opus-5-5` 设成了默认模型，所以一启动就能看到。

## 环境

- magpie 0.1.2124（macOS 15.7.7，arm64）
- Droid 1.0.0
- 上游：Claude Code 订阅（provider `claude`）

## magpie 写入的配置（apiKey 已省略）

| model | provider | baseUrl |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `claude/claude-opus-5-5`、`claude/claude-sonnet-5-5`、`claude/claude-haiku-5-5` | `generic-chat-completion-api` | `http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1` |
| `auto/claude-opus-5-5`、`auto/claude-haiku-5-5`（路由组） | `generic-chat-completion-api` | `http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1` |
| `factory/claude-opus-5-5`、`factory/claude-haiku-5-5` | `anthropic` | `http://127.0.0.1:3425` |
| `codex/*` | `openai` | `http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1` |

同样是 Claude 模型，`factory/*` 写的是 `anthropic`，`claude/*` 和 `auto/claude-*` 却写成了 Chat。

## 原因推测

应该和 #3514 是同一个根本原因：订阅类 provider 的 `Native()` 返回空，`magpieModels` 就不给这些模型写 `APIs`，于是 Droid 的配置也落到了兜底的 Chat。#3514 讲的是 dsh，Droid 这边同样受影响，而且 Droid 会直接报错。

除了报错，走 Chat 格式还会丢掉 thinking 签名和 `cache_control`（见 #329、#3514）。

另外，路由组（`auto/*`）是故意统一用 Chat 的。但组名里带 `claude`，同样会触发 Droid 的检查。

## 建议

1. Claude Code 订阅的 Claude 模型写成 `"provider": "anthropic"`，baseUrl 用网关根地址（不带 `/v1`），和 `factory/*` 保持一致。
2. 名字里带 claude 的路由组，要么换个 Droid 不会识别成 Claude 的 model id，要么组成员全是 Claude 时也改写成 `anthropic`。

因为 magpie 每次同步都会重写 `custom:magpie/*`（#2773），用户手动改配置留不住，只能在 magpie 这边修。

issue.title: dsh: magpie-anthropic route omits allowEmptySignature — unsigned thinking is replayed as text, leaking English CoT into the answer (mixed-language output)

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
### magpie version

v0.1.4204

### Where

Gateway only

### OS

macOS (DSH client) + Linux (magpie in Docker on a NAS)

### Agent, provider and model

DeepSeek Harness (dsh 0.2.2-rc.3) → magpie-anthropic (anthropic-messages) → qoder/qmodel_latest, trae-cn/kimi-k3.1-pro (non-Claude reasoning models)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Connect DSH to magpie over the anthropic-messages route (magpie's own dsh adapter writes the `magpie-anthropic` route, or any equivalent anthropic-messages config).
2. Pick a non-Claude reasoning model (e.g. `qoder/qmodel_latest` or `trae-cn/kimi-k3.1-pro`). These return thinking blocks with `signature: ""`.
3. Ask in Chinese and let the agent run several tool-call steps within one turn.
4. Watch the assistant turns: after a step that produced a thinking block, a later step returns NO thinking block and instead puts the English chain-of-thought into the visible `text`, then switches back to Chinese.

### What happened, and what you expected

Happened: the model's English internal reasoning leaks into the visible answer, producing mixed Chinese/English output. In our session logs, EVERY step that flipped from "has reasoning" to "no reasoning + English text" immediately followed a step whose thinking block had an empty signature. Native Claude (real signatures) and DSH's own DeepSeek adapter (which keeps thinking as thinking) never showed this.

Expected: the model's reasoning stays in the thinking channel across turns, and the visible answer stays in the user's language.

Root cause (cross magpie ↔ DSH):

- magpie sends non-Claude thinking blocks with `signature: ""` (the anthropic encoder / thinking_signature.go). This is correct: these vendors have no signature.
- magpie's dsh adapter writes only `compat.forceAdaptiveThinking` for these models (`internal/agent/dsh.go`: `dshPiCompat` struct ~L2052; generation ~L2281). It does NOT set `allowEmptySignature`.
- DSH's pi-ai defaults `allowEmptySignature=false`, so on the NEXT request it rewrites each unsigned historical thinking block into a plain assistant `text` block (pi-ai anthropic-messages `convertMessages`). The model then sees its own English reasoning as prior visible text and imitates it: it stops using the thinking channel and writes English CoT into `text`.

This is likely the missing "client-replayed request body" that #2048 asked for: the leak is history-dependent and grows within a session, because each leaked turn re-enters history as text.

Suggested fix (magpie side): in `dshPiCompat` add

```go
AllowEmptySignature bool `yaml:"allowEmptySignature,omitempty"`
```

and set it true for non-Claude models routed to `magpie-anthropic` (the same place that sets `ForceAdaptiveThinking` today). Real Claude models keep their signatures and are unaffected. DSH already exposes `compat.allowEmptySignature` (0.2.x), and pi-ai added the flag in 0.77.0 (#4464).

Note: we have since moved to a Chat/Responses connector (dsh-magpie-connect), which does not use anthropic-messages and therefore avoids this. The gap still exists in current main's dsh.go for anyone on the magpie-anthropic route.

Related: #2048 (same symptom), #3514 (dsh Claude routing losing signatures).

### Error text or logs

```text
Sanitized illustration (no keys/tokens):

# assistant turn N (has reasoning, empty signature):
content: [ {type:"reasoning", thinking:"...English plan..."},
           {type:"text", text:"<Chinese>"},
           {type:"tool_use", ...} ]
replayState.blocks: [ {type:"reasoning", thinkingSignature:""}, ... ]

# assistant turn N+1 (reasoning gone, English leaked into text):
content: [ {type:"text",
            text:"Now I have a fully verified picture. Let me compose the
                  final answer in Chinese. ...<English CoT>... <Chinese answer>"},
           {type:"tool_use", ...} ]
# no thinking block this turn; the prior turn's signature was "".
```
